101-webgl-color-space.visual_critic_note: Dark theme and clean controls show design intent, but low-lightness colors at the bottom of the OKLCH cylinder blend into the #1a1a1a background, undermining the visualization's core purpose of showing the full color space.
101-webgl-color-space.encoding_integrity_note: 3D cylindrical OKLCH scatter plot with self-referential color encoding (each dot colored by the color it represents) is structurally honest — H→angle, C→radius, L→Y mappings are mathematically faithful with no baseline, lie-factor, or dual-axis issues; hardcoded view-scaling constants (×6, ×4) are aesthetic parameters, not domain distortions.
flags: Update Storm (hover: O(N) projection loop on every pointermove, no RAF coalescing)
Update Storm (sliders: gl.bufferSubData called on every input tick, no debounce)
Unnecessary resize() called on every animation frame
101-webgl-color-space.stress_test_note: Core WebGL render loop is RAF-correct, but un-throttled O(N) hover projection on pointermove and un-debounced slider GPU uploads are update-storm violations that will cause jank under rapid input.
101-webgl-color-space.cognitive_load_note: Single-view 3D point cloud with self-encoding colors (each dot IS its color), two simple filter controls, and hover tooltip — the conceptual model is immediate and the low working-memory demand keeps it clear despite 1500 points; the only friction is that depth ambiguity in the static view makes the cylindrical OKLCH structure hard to read without rotating.
